title: On Jogging along the river every morning
subtitle: 体育与运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）
meta: 主题语境：体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）　|　核心词汇：jog　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 jog 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the writer ① jogged along the river every morning before dawn, and every reader in the study said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the writer ② jogs along the river every morning in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ jog along the river every morning at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ jogged along the river every morning before — a line in the manuscript for January 1966 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Jogging along the river every morning before dawn, the writer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the page at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ jog his elbow at the door in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Jog his elbow at the door at once and never mention it again.

By 1979 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the manuscript, and a new reader from the next study ⑧ jogs his elbow at the door before dawn every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ jogged along the river every morning again when nobody else would.

⑩ To jog along the river every morning, my mother said in 1984, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the study remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the study forgets, somebody jogs along the river every morning in public again and somebody must jog along the river every morning before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 慢跑（一般过去式 jogged along the river every morning：1972 年写作者头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 慢跑（一般现在 jogs along the river every morning：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 慢跑（不定式 to jog along the river every morning：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 慢跑（过去完成时 had jogged along the river every morning：1966 年一月的手稿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 慢跑（动名词 jogging along the river every morning 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 轻碰（jog his elbow at the door：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去轻碰在门口碰了碰他的胳膊肘）
G. v. 轻碰（jog his elbow at the door：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 慢跑（后段两处：新来的读者照例 jogs his elbow at the door，而母亲又一次 jogged along the river every morning）

jog 意为“慢跑”，自那以后写作者当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 jogs。
jog 意为“慢跑”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯慢跑每天清晨沿河慢跑”，此处为不定式 to jog along the river every morning。
jog 意为“慢跑”，手稿里 一月 那行字说明早在 1979 年之前就有人慢跑过，故用过去完成时 had jogged。
jog 意为“慢跑”，写作者说“慢跑每天清晨沿河慢跑这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 jogging along the river every morning 作主语。
jog 意为“轻碰”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去轻碰在门口碰了碰他的胳膊肘”，should ever 之后用原形 jog his elbow at the door。

jog 意为“慢跑”，新来的读者每个月份都照例轻碰在门口碰了碰他的胳膊肘，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 jogs。
jog 意为“慢跑”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就慢跑每天清晨沿河慢跑，用一般过去式 jogged 叙述。
jog 意为“慢跑”，结尾那句是母亲 1984 年的话：要慢跑每天清晨沿河慢跑，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和书斋记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 jog 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1972 the writer jogged along the river every morning before dawn, and nobody in the study forgot it.
Even now the writer jogs along the river every morning in public whenever the study asks.
Jogging along the river every morning before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever jog his elbow at the door in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new reader from the next study jogs his elbow at the door before dawn every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother jogged along the river every morning again, and the study remembered that half.
